The theorem completely classifies a canonical mixed curved-flat support over all odd finite fields; the new cross-collision reveals j=0 elliptic arithmetic in a fourth Fourier moment even though the individual components have elementary energy. The exact fibers and prime-power recurrence make the natural invariant reusable for finite-field restriction and sampling comparisons.
